output.headline: Provider-focused sponsor whose $77M median deal matches the $80M dental target; its 12.5x median price is the hurdle.
output.differentiator: Most adjacent provider deals (20) of any buyer on the priority list, and a $77M median deal closer to the target's $80M than any other sponsor's.
output.why_them: Provider specialist sponsor; size fits; must stretch on price

acquirer_overview.title: Provider-heavy sponsor with a steady, high-closing record
points: Financial sponsor with 24 deals from 2016 to 2024; 21 of 24 (88%) closed and 22 of 24 (92%) were control deals. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share]
Two deals in dental, 20 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; physician groups lead with 10. Provider deals are 22 of 24. [T:record, K:by_sub_sector, A:angles]
Healthcare is one of four core industries; Fund XI closed at its EUR 9 billion hard cap (about $11 billion). [P:1, P:2]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Dental experience plus size fit, with no open platform
points: Platform Build is a stated motive in 7 of 24 deals, giving a basis for a dental add-on thesis. [M:platform_build]
Signals for: modest factors on sub-sector relevance and deal count, and a slight factor that $80M is not below its usual range. [S:sector_rel, S:activity, S:not_smaller]
Against: a slight factor on region, with only 1 of 24 deals in the Southeast. No open platform in the sub-sector. [S:geo_fit, K:by_region, A:angles]

precedent_activity.title: Two prior dental bolt-ons, both far larger than this target
points: Highland Dental Solutions, 2022: $222M bolt-on at 11.6x EV/EBITDA, closed. [D:MA-2022-0103]
Horizon Dental Management, 2020: $249M bolt-on at 16.4x, closed, showing it will pay up in dental. [D:MA-2020-0386]
Principal Physician Group, 2024: $76M recapitalization at 15.9x, closed; this is the closest in size to the target. [D:MA-2024-0431]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, but this buyer pays less
points: 63 comparable deals show 11.0x at the 25th percentile, 13.7x median and 15.4x at the 75th percentile. [V:comps]
The 75th percentile is defensible: the target's 18.0% margin is above the comps' median of 12.4%, and above 92% of comps. [V:comps]
Its own median is 12.5x. At 5.0x leverage and an equity cheque of $53M, IRR at the ask is 14.0% against a 20% target. [V:comps, V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Price gap
risk_flags.concern: Its returns do not clear at the $80M ask.
risk_flags.mitigant: The 18.0% margin supports upper-quartile pricing in the comparable set.
risk_flags.reality: IRR at the ask is 14.0% against 20%; maximum price is $68M on either exit. [V:lbo, V:comps]

risk_flags.title: No open dental platform
risk_flags.concern: It has no open platform in the sub-sector to absorb the target.
risk_flags.mitigant: It has completed two dental bolt-ons and has a stated platform-build motive.
risk_flags.reality: Open platform is no; both dental deals were bolt-ons, and those are the only two in the file. [A:angles, D:MA-2022-0103, D:MA-2020-0386]

risk_flags.title: Southeast and priority
risk_flags.concern: Little regional footprint, and low standing on the list.
risk_flags.mitigant: Its size fit and provider record are strong, and 21 of 24 deals closed.
risk_flags.reality: One Southeast deal; ranked 9th of 10 with a 4.7% likelihood. [K:by_region, R:rank, K:closed_share]

conviction.rationale: Based on 2 deals in the target's own sub-sector and 20 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, offset by no open platform in the sub-sector. Return shortfall at the ask keeps this a lower-priority call. [C:conviction, T:record, V:lbo]
